Cross-validation folds of cells

Source: R/caller.R
assign_folds.Rd

Random, balanced folds over cells (or over their origins: spiked copies inherit the fold of the cell they were made from, so a copy and its original are never in different folds).

Usage

assign_folds(cells, n_folds = 4, seed = 1, origin = NULL)

Arguments

cells

cell ids (may repeat, e.g. one per row)

n_folds

number of folds

seed

RNG seed

origin

optional origin id per entry of cells

Value

integer fold (1..n_folds) per entry of cells
